name: Dharma Merchant Services

google.heading: Dharma Merchant Services on Google
google.summary: Fourteen reviews and a 4.4 average, and almost all of them are around nine years old. Read this as a snapshot of Dharma in the mid-2010s rather than as a current rating, and note that the listing now shows a Montclair, New Jersey address rather than the San Francisco one the company was known for. What the old reviews say is coherent and unusual for merchant services: customers who found Dharma while researching B Corporations, stayed for years, and credited it with saving them thousands after leaving First Data. Interchange plus pricing and a company whose values they could name are the two things they mention. The two one-star reviews are a decade apart and one is a billing dispute the reviewer reported as fraud. Fourteen reviews is not a rating, and nine-year-old reviews are not current, so use this as context and check the pricing yourself.

quotes.text: I have been a Dharma Merchant Services customer since 2014. I think found them while doing research on B Corporations, which are for profit but have social accountability baked in.
I started with First Data and had nothing but trouble with them. I did an search and found Dharma Merchant Services and I've never, ever made a better choice.

noRedditReason: Dharma has almost no Reddit presence. It appears occasionally as a name in interchange-plus recommendation threads, but nobody has written up using it, so there is no discussion to summarise without padding it out with mentions.
